description: Generate an Executive Trust & Compliance Dossier (ETD) for B2B enterprise procurement and vendor onboarding. Includes Executive Passport, vector data flow diagram, tripartite evidence grid, and procurement approval memo. When no license key is provided, returns an executive preview and instant checkout link.

ai_provider.description: Optional primary AI provider (default 'Mistral AI / EU Sovereign').

company_name.description: Name of the organisation or product.

polar_license_key.description: Optional Polar license key (e.g. ec_live_... or license purchased via Polar). If omitted, returns executive preview and instant unlock link.

name: generate_executive_trust_dossier

outputSchema.description: Dossier output with status, verification ID, HTML/Markdown content, and checkout link if unpaid.
